§6Matter Transmitters & Receivers§f

§aTeleport anywhere, no more walking like a peasant.§f

Set up a §bMatter Transmitter§f (departure) and §bMatter Receiver§f (destination), then use a §bDialing Device§f to connect them. A blue beam appears, step in and you're there.

§6Specs§f:
§b• Transmitter§f: §e200,000 RF§f buffer, §e1,000 RF/t§f
§b• Receiver§f: §e100,000 RF§f buffer, §e500 RF/t§f
§b• Dialing Device§f: §e50,000 RF§f, connects within §e10h×5v§f range

§6Teleport Costs§f:
§b• Same dimension§f: §e5,000 RF§f base + §e10 RF/block§f
§b• Cross-dimension§f: §e100,000 RF§f flat
§b• Receiver arrival§f: §e5,000 RF§f from receiver buffer
§b• Beam maintenance§f: §e500 RF/t§f while active

If a receiver runs dry, a §bMatter Booster§f next to the transmitter forces it through for §c20,000 RF§f extra.

§9Note:§f Name your transmitters and receivers in their GUIs for easy identification in the dialing device.
